one_line: Western Chalukya emperor of Kalyani who proclaimed the Chalukya-Vikrama era and ruled the Deccan for fifty years.

appearance.age_look: mid-30s, tall and athletic with a regal, disciplined bearing
appearance.face: oval face, medium-brown Deccan complexion, straight sharp nose, well-defined jaw, neatly trimmed medium mustache with a short goatee, calm intense eyes with slightly arched brows and a composed, confident default expression
appearance.hair: thick black hair pulled into a high, smooth warrior’s topknot at the back of the crown, with the front hair oiled flat; wrapped with a narrow gold band, and topped by a modest cylindrical golden crown-ring decorated with small leaf motifs and a single central red gemstone
appearance.costume: Western Chalukya royal attire: a long-sleeved fitted angarkha-style tunic of rich deep maroon silk reaching mid-thigh, with a wrap-over front edged in intricate gold embroidery; around the waist a broad golden cloth belt with woven geometric patterns, securing a cream-colored cotton dhoti pleated neatly to ankle length and draped in the Deccan style with a front fan-like fold; over his shoulders a flowing teal silk uttariya (shawl) with thin gold borders, one end looping across his chest and the other hanging behind; on his neck a layered set of gold necklaces with flat pendants, on wrists heavy gold kadas (bracelets), and simple gold finger-rings; feet in brown leather strapped sandals with small metal studs, and on the upper arms plain gold armlets shaped as subtle makara motifs.
appearance.signature: a long steel Deccan sword with a gently curved single-edged blade, a distinctive Indian disc pommel, and a slightly flared cross-guard, sheathed in a dark brown leather scabbard with gold fittings and carried at his left hip

ref_desc: Vikramaditya VI has a medium-brown oval face with a mustache and goatee, black topknot hair with a gold crown-ring, wearing a deep maroon angarkha, cream dhoti, teal uttariya, gold ornaments, brown sandals, and carrying a curved Deccan sword with a disc pommel.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character of Vikramaditya VI, shown front-on in a neutral stance: a tall, athletic Deccan king in his mid-30s with a medium-brown oval face, sharp nose, calm intense eyes, neatly trimmed mustache and short goatee. His black hair is oiled smooth at the front and tied into a high topknot, wrapped with a narrow gold band and topped by a modest cylindrical golden crown-ring featuring small leaf motifs and one central red gemstone. He wears a long-sleeved, fitted deep maroon silk angarkha-style tunic with a wrap-over front and fine gold embroidery along the edges, belted at the waist with a broad golden cloth belt in geometric patterns. Below, a cream cotton dhoti is pleated and draped to the ankles in Western Deccan style, and over his shoulders a teal silk uttariya with thin gold borders crosses his chest and flows down his back. Adorn him with layered gold necklaces with flat pendants, plain gold armlets on his upper arms, heavy gold bracelets at the wrists, and simple gold rings on his fingers. Put brown leather strapped sandals with small metal studs on his feet. At his left hip, show his signature weapon: a long, gently curved steel Deccan sword with a single-edged blade, distinctive Indian disc pommel, and slightly flared cross-guard, sheathed in a dark brown leather scabbard with gold fittings. Use a palette dominated by deep maroon, cream, teal, gold, and brown, keeping the costume and accessories historically grounded to an 11th–12th century Western Chalukya emperor.
